namespace = cosmo_dipevents_events


# brothel first menu


# Sacrifice Mount Bromo menu
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_dipevents_events.101
	title = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.t
	desc = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.d
	picture = cosmogfx_SACRIFICE_VOLCANO_1_eventPicture
	
	
	
	trigger = {
		ai = no
	OR = {	
		any_known_country = {
			has_opinion_modifier = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_send_sacrifice
			}
			primary_culture = javanese
			owns = 627
			}			
		}
	}

		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 1
		}	
	
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_send_sacrifice
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = sacrificecountry
				}
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_send_sacrifice
					}
				}
					remove_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_send_sacrifice
					}
				}							
				}
				}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.a
		trigger = {
			always = yes
		}
		kill_ruler = yes
		add_prestige = -15		
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.b
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		}
		kill_heir = { allow_new_heir = no }	
		add_prestige = -10		
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.c
		trigger = {
			has_consort = yes 
		}
		random_known_country = {
			limit = {
				is_origin_of_consort = ROOT 
			}
			add_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_sacrificed_queen
			}			
		}
		remove_consort = yes
		add_prestige = -5		
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.7
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			advisor = philosopher 	
			advisor = natural_scientist 	
			advisor = artist 	
			advisor = treasurer 	
			advisor = theologian 	
			advisor = master_of_mint 	
			advisor = inquisitor 	 	
			}
		}
		kill_advisor = philosopher		
		kill_advisor = natural_scientist		
		kill_advisor = artist		
		kill_advisor = treasurer		
		kill_advisor = theologian		
		kill_advisor = master_of_mint		
		kill_advisor = inquisitor				
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.8
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			advisor = trader 	
			advisor = statesman 	
			advisor = naval_reformer 	
			advisor = spymaster 	
			advisor = colonial_governor 	
			advisor = diplomat 	
			advisor = navigator 	 	
			}
		}
		kill_advisor = trader		
		kill_advisor = statesman		
		kill_advisor = naval_reformer		
		kill_advisor = spymaster		
		kill_advisor = colonial_governor		
		kill_advisor = diplomat		
		kill_advisor = navigator				
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.9
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			advisor = army_reformer 	
			advisor = army_organiser 	
			advisor = commandant 	
			advisor = quartermaster 	
			advisor = recruitmaster 	
			advisor = fortification_expert 	
			advisor = grand_captain 	 	
			}
		}
		kill_advisor = army_reformer		
		kill_advisor = army_organiser		
		kill_advisor = commandant		
		kill_advisor = quartermaster		
		kill_advisor = recruitmaster		
		kill_advisor = fortification_expert		
		kill_advisor = grand_captain				
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.10
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 		
			}
		}
			set_ruler_flag = concubine_sacrifice				
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.11
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			}
		}
			set_ruler_flag = concubine_sacrifice				
		}		
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.12
		trigger = {
			has_estate = estate_madams 	
		}
			set_ruler_flag = prostitute_sacrifice
			country_event = {
			id = cosmo_brothel_events.101
		}						
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_dipevents_events.101.13						
		}																	
}
